description: This is a minimalist cantilever chair, featuring a sleek chrome-plated steel frame and a black leather seat and back. The frame is constructed from bent tubular steel, creating a continuous, flowing line that forms the legs, armrests, and support for the seating surface. The seat and back are made of a durable, textured black material, likely leather or a high-quality synthetic, providing both comfort and a sophisticated aesthetic. The chair's design emphasizes simplicity, functionality, and the purity of its materials, showcasing the elegance of industrial design. It appears to be a single, rather than a set, as only two are depicted with shadows suggesting they are the only items present in the scene.
